Supply And Trading
children.description: Supply And Trading Includes Processes Such As Managing Supply, Demand And Trading Of Crude Oil And Refined Products. It Involves Trading As Well As Planning & Managing Movements In The Most Efficient Way, Including Primary & Secondary Distribution.

children.name: Trading Management
children.description: Trading management consists of processes performed in the front office such as forecasting, pre-trade analysis, managing counterparty credit and contracts, executing and capturing trades.

children.name: Confirmations & Risk Management
children.description: Confirmations and Risk management consists of processes performed in the middle office to minimize risk of losses in the trading book due to change in market conditions i.e. commodity prices, interest rates, credit spreads, foreign-exchange rates. Middle office is responsible for managing confirmations, scenario modelling and price forecasting.

children.name: Actualizations
children.description: Actualizations is performed by scheduler who assigns the final ticket volumes to the trades according to the preset priority.

children.name: Settlements & Accounting
children.description: Settlements and Accounting process covers deal attributes and deal terms at time of trade execution with counterparty through netting, invoicing and settlement post trade expiry and various accounting postings throughout deal lifecycle.

children.name: Reconcile Economic PNL To Accounting PNL
Crude/Feed Supply Chain Management
children.description: Crude/feed supply chain management consists of processes required to plan, organize, coordinate & control crude/feed supply & processing at the refinery. This includes crude/feed transportation, slate, and supply & demand management.

children.name: Plan Optimal Feedstock Slate And Run Rate
Refined Product Supply Chain Management
children.description: Refined product supply chain management consist of processes that are required to maintain an optimal supply network. This covers the generation of the demand forecast, associated customer allocations, the demand & supply balancing process & the execution of terminal replenishment.

children.name: Products Distribution Management
children.description: Product distribution management involves managing product and transportation agreements, terminal operations.

children.name: Marketing
children.description: Marketing Includes Processes Such As Performing Market Analysis, Developing Marketing Strategy, New Product Development, Managing Retail Marketing Operations. It Includes Processes Required To Take The Products & Services From Strategic Conception, Through Planning To Operational Execution.

children.name: Market Analysis & Insight
children.description: Market analysis & insight process determines market attractiveness & identifies evolving opportunities & threats as to the industry in general & company specifically.

children.name: Strategy
children.description: Strategy process establishes target markets to work in and, at a micro level, provides the strategy for where store locations should be established. For B2B this considers supply envelopes & establishes target geographic markets.

children.name: Marketing & Sales Operations Planning

Customer Service & Support
children.description: Customer service & support consist of processes such as all support & service offerings to consumers & business partners both from a conceptual & operational view. It ranges from defining the methods of interaction (e.g., on site, call center, web), along defining, setting up & operating facilities & technology down to managing service staff.

children.name: Terminal Loading
children.description: Terminal Loading consist of processes such as monitoring customer sales activity and implementing control strategies based upon supply, customer credit and/or contract limitations. Allocation decisions are based on evaluating deals and transaction data to determine which product at the terminal should be made available to the customers. It is responsible for sending locks and unlocks to the terminal when it determines that availability should change.
